metadata.name: Country investment tier mapping
metadata.ruleSummary: Only manually approved prestige countries are allowed. Borderline and unknown are not allowed by default. Unknown/not manually approved = exclude.

tiers.borderline: Shown separately; not allowed by default unless user changes it

notes: This is a practical user-preference investment filter, not an official democracy index.
The file includes ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries from pycountry plus XK Kosovo as a common extra code.
Edit individual countries as your opinion changes.
